text:
The plate is roughly 26 cm across and spans about 450 px, so 1 cm is about 17 px.

The meat pieces cover about 170 px by 100 px, which is roughly 10 cm by 5 cm. They look like 2-3 thin slices of flank steak or similar beef, each about 1 cm thick. That gives a volume of about 10 × 3 × 1 × 2 ≈ 60-80 cm³, or about 70-80 g. There may be a little sauce on top.

Cooked flank steak runs about 2 kcal/g, so 75 g is about 150 kcal. I'll round up slightly for the sauce.
